Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Haqim's Law: Retribution

Put this card in play. During a bleed action, an Banu Haqim you control can discard a combat card to get +1 bleed.

i understand if you have 2 Haqim's Law: Retribution you can discard 2 combat cards to get +2 bleed,but after you discard one card,do you replace this card before discard another card?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
You use one effect after the other, replacing any card discarded one after the other.
